**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] The user is interested in creating a B2B marketing strategy for a company supplying the UK’s KBB and furniture industry.
- [FACT] The company is described as an internationally-trusted manufacturer and distributor of furniture fittings, accessories, hardware, and ironmongery.
- [FACT] The company offers 25,000 globally-sourced products in stock and provides free next day delivery.
- [PREFERENCE] The user is focused on customer engagement and acquisition for furniture manufacturers, kitchen designers, and installers.
- [EVENT] The user is seeking to develop a content strategy based on recent research findings.
- [TEMPORAL] The session date is 2023/05/22 (Mon) 04:48.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested a content strategy that includes educational blog posts, social media campaigns, an inspiration gallery, email newsletters, and collaborations with influencers and industry experts.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended conducting a content audit, creating a content calendar, developing a content plan, identifying key influencers, creating a content style guide, and developing a reporting framework as priorities for the first 90 days as a creative content manager.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant outlined that developing a reporting framework involves defining marketing objectives, identifying metrics to track, choosing tools, setting up tracking and reporting, and analyzing data to optimize the strategy.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided a list of key metrics to track customer engagement and acquisition, including website traffic, time on site, bounce rate, conversion rate, social media engagement, and email open and click-through rates.
